neighbours.label: The word-initial piece ' v' / ' V' (and '_v' in code) when the tokenizer splits a v-word (v|ases, v|etch, V|ient|iane, _v1): a spelling unit
fire: The monks copied the gospels onto fine vellum by candlelight.
In the fable, a clever vixen tricks the farmer out of his hens.
The meadow was full of clover, purple vetch and tall grasses.
Our cat brought a small vole into the kitchen this morning.
Wine was left to ferment in large oak vats for a full year.
The nurse lined up the glass vials on the steel tray.
Después de la cena, los niños vieron una película juntos.
From Bangkok we took a slow train north to Vientiane.
quiet: The monks copied the gospels onto fine paper by candlelight.
In the fable, a clever fox tricks the farmer out of his hens.
The meadow was full of clover, purple thistle and tall grasses.
Our cat brought a small mouse into the kitchen this morning.
Wine was left to ferment in large oak barrels for a full year.
The nurse lined up the glass bottles on the steel tray.
Después de la cena, los niños jugaron juntos en el jardín.
From Bangkok we took a slow train north to Laos.
